# XCP-ng: References

Always prefer current XCP-ng and Xen Orchestra documentation; defaults and features change between
releases.

Last verified: 2026-10-31

## Vendor (authoritative)

- Release history and support dates: https://docs.xcp-ng.org/releases
- XCP-ng 8.3 release notes: https://docs.xcp-ng.org/releases/release-8-3
- XCP-ng 8.3 is now LTS (2025-06): https://xcp-ng.org/blog/2025/06/16/xcp-ng-8-3-is-now-lts/
- XCP-ng 8.2 LTS end of life (2025-09): https://xcp-ng.org/blog/2025/09/16/xcp-ng-8-2-lts-reached-its-end-of-life/
- Updates (yum, Rolling Pool Update, repositories, reboot guidance): https://docs.xcp-ng.org/management/updates/
- Users and permissions (single root, RBAC, AD deprecation, XO ACLs, SSH): https://docs.xcp-ng.org/management/users-permissions/
- XO Lite (access, disabling it): https://docs.xcp-ng.org/management/manage-locally/xo-lite/
- Xen Orchestra web UI (XOA vs. XO from sources): https://docs.xcp-ng.org/management/manage-at-scale/xo-web-ui/
- Backup (XO backup types, remotes, metadata and XO config backups): https://docs.xcp-ng.org/management/backup/
- `xe` CLI reference: https://docs.xcp-ng.org/management/manage-locally/cli/
- Connectivity requirements (ports between XO, hosts, and clusters):
  https://help.vates.tech/kb/en-us/63-networking/131-connectivity-requirements
- Xen Orchestra documentation (installation, users, ACLs, authentication plugins, backups):
  https://docs.xen-orchestra.com/
- XCP-ng blog, update and security announcements: https://xcp-ng.org/blog/
- XCP-ng forum, update announcements and testing: https://xcp-ng.org/forum/

## Upstream

- Xen Project security advisories (XSAs): https://xenbits.xen.org/xsa/
- IEEE OUI registry (to confirm MAC prefix owners): https://regauth.standards.ieee.org/standards-ra-web/pub/view.html#registries

BMC vendors (Dell iDRAC, HPE iLO, Supermicro and others) publish their own security advisories and
hardening guides; use the current page for the specific server model.

Generic vulnerability and incident sources (CISA KEV, NVD, CVE, CISA ransomware guidance, IC3) are listed in
the core documents.

## Third-party (not authoritative)

- Thomas-Krenn wiki, XCP-ng version information: https://www.thomas-krenn.com/en/wiki/Version_information_on_XCP-ng
  Convenient release summary. Confirm dates on the XCP-ng release page.
- endoflife.date, XCP-ng: https://endoflife.date/xcp-ng Overview only; it has lagged the vendor's
  announced dates before.
